content_sections.heading: CCI Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates are shortlisted for Interview based on the declaration made in the application form. If a large number of applications are received for a post, shortlisting will additionally consider relevant experience, current CTC/monthly pay, and higher qualification based on the enclosed documents. Where required, a Written Test or Group Discussion may be conducted for shortlisted candidates before the Interview. Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents supporting their eligibility at the time of Interview; failure to do so means they will not be permitted to appear, and Travelling Allowance will not be reimbursed. Candidates called for interview are eligible for sleeper-class train fare (shortest route) between their declared correspondence address and the interview venue, only if the distance exceeds 50 km. Other things being equal, candidates with additional relevant professional qualifications and cement-industry experience will be given preference. Candidates shortlisted after interview must undergo a Medical Examination , with reports signed by the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) of a Government Hospital in CCI's prescribed format, examined by CCI's Medical Officer before document verification. Candidates found medically unfit will not proceed to document verification. Document Verification requires original documents and photocopies; candidates whose documents are not in order will be summarily rejected. Candidates must clear every stage (including the medical examination) successfully to be adjudged suitable for selection; the Corporation's decision is final.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form (Word/PDF format) from the "Career" section of www.cciltd.in . Fill the form (typed and printed, if possible) with accurate personal, qualification and experience details. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (see Documents Required below), along with the Demand Draft for the application fee, if applicable. Send the completed application by ordinary post in a cover super-scribed "Application for the post of ______" to: HOD (HR), Cement Corporation of India Limited, Post Box No.: 3061, Lodhi Road Post Office, New Delhi – 110003 Important: No other mode or format of application will be accepted; applications in other formats will be rejected. Applications must reach the above address by 15 September 2026, 5:00 PM . CCI is not responsible for postal delay, loss or non-delivery.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has CCI advertised in 2026?
faq.answer: CCI has advertised 14 posts on Fixed Term Contract basis - Engineer (8), Officer (4) and Analyst (2) - under Advertisement No. CO/03/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CCI recruitment?
faq.answer: Completed applications must reach CCI's New Delhi office by post by 15 September 2026, 5:00 PM. This is also the cut-off date for age and experience.

faq.question: Q3. Can CCI recruitment be applied for online?
faq.answer: No. Applications must be submitted offline, by downloading the prescribed form from cciltd.in and sending it by post; online or emailed applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the tenure of the Fixed Term Contract?
faq.answer: The initial tenure is 1 year, extendable up to a maximum of 4 years based on performance. It is not a permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration for CCI Fixed Term Contract posts?
faq.answer: A consolidated contractual fee of ₹40,000 per month, plus accommodation as per entitlement (Units) or ₹10,000/month for accommodation (Corporate/Regional/Zonal Office), with a 5% annual increment after 1 year.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CCI recruitment?
faq.answer: ₹100 via Demand Draft for UR/OBC/EWS candidates; SC/ST/PWD/Female candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for CCI posts?
faq.answer: 35 years for Engineer and Officer posts, and 40 years for the Analyst (Finance & Accounts) post, as on the cut-off date of 15 September 2026, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Ex-Servicemen as applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a written exam for CCI recruitment?
faq.answer: No fixed written exam is specified; selection is primarily through interview, with a written test or group discussion conducted before the interview only if CCI deems it necessary.
